source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For DBViewWrapper grouped-by-sort, groups already sort their messages by date. Validate the primary sort type and replace an invalid primary with byDate. Do not reject a valid primary just because a saved secondary sort is bySize. The May 2024 fix also rejects byUnread and byJunkStatus, and byLocation for a single-folder view.
title: Validate the primary sort only when grouping a message view
